columns.attributes: Parsed fields intended for faceted BOM matching. descriptionRaw remains the source of truth.

recommendedMatchingLogic: Normalize the BOM pipe item description using the same rules and first check indices.byLookupKey.
If a lookupKey returns one material number, use it directly.
If a lookupKey returns multiple material numbers, show all candidates to the user because the source has duplicate or near-duplicate descriptions.
If there is no exact description match, filter records by sizeInch or sizeNps, then schedule or thicknessMm, then endConnections, then dimensionalStandards, then materialSpecs, then serviceTags.
Never silently force a match when several candidates remain. Show the candidate list for engineering review.
